fields.label: Project Description
fields.value: The Total Project Area of the Mixed used Development is 233255.34 sqmts , out of which 200812.59 sq mts is earmarked for development of IT/BT,ITes, commercial office Retail & Retail space and the same is not for sale. The balance portion of 43,915.75 sq mts is earmarked for Residential development of which 18413.16 sq mts has already been developed into apartments (zenith-building No.4) and the Occupation Certificate has been obtained. We now have applied for RERA registration for apartments (called Vario Homes- Building No.8- for sale )to be developed on 12755 sqmts of land in Sy No.59/4 & 60/14. and on the balance (Residential earmarked) land of 18716.67 sqmts , we are developing residential apartment (called Pinnical Building No.7) for Land owners Own use and Not for Sale.
